params.body:
Fifth measurement to carry verdicts.

| facet | thresholds, worst first |
| --- | --- |
| malware | `MALWARE_FOUND` (now), `MALWARE_FREE` (ok) |
| runtime | `VULN_RUNTIME_CRITICAL` (week), `VULN_RUNTIME_HIGH` (month), `VULN_RUNTIME_FOUND` (background), `VULN_RUNTIME_FREE` (ok) |
| packages | `VULN_FOUND` (background), `VULN_FREE` (ok) |

The ladder is Portal's card, copied: the judgement follows what the site runs, and a critical advisory in build tooling stays background. Two flat facts (`runtimeCritical`, `runtimeHigh`, read out of the runtime tally) make that a registry matter instead of a `match` in PHP. The six existing entries gain a level; two are new.

Tests: four cases in `VulnerabilitiesScanTest`, one end to end with a critical advisory stubbed. Suite 597 green, PHPStan and Pint clean. Portal follows with the Packages card reading the three facets.
params.title: Vulnerabilities judges its own facts, by what the site runs
